# Quarkus Patterns

Curated by Skill Harbor: a patterns skill for building Quarkus 3.x services the cloud-native way. It covers the layered structure (resource to service to repository), REST API design with JAX-RS and RESTEasy Reactive, CDI services with constructor injection, data access through Hibernate Panache, and event-driven flows with Apache Camel and RabbitMQ. Async processing with CompletableFuture, validation, exception mapping, pagination, and YAML profiles for dev/staging/production round it out, plus notes on GraalVM native compilation. The examples are real service classes, so you see the transactional boundaries and publisher wiring instead of abstract advice. By @affaan-m, listed here with credit to its creator. From the affaan-m/ECC repository (MIT). Honest caveats: pure guidance, nothing to install; assumes a Quarkus project and Java basics; Camel/RabbitMQ sections need a broker to be useful; native-image notes assume GraalVM. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
